title: Maareecha's advise to Ravana
introduction: Maareecha advises Ravana to stay away from Rama with his own unpleasant experience with Rama's arrow when he was in Tataka forest, and portrays a gruesome picture of Rama to Ravana, asking him to not to meddle with Rama's affairs.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे सप्त त्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 37th chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
तत् श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वाक्यम् वाक्य विशारदः |
प्रत्युवाच महाप्राज्ञो मारीचो राक्षसेश्वरम्
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā rākṣasendrasya vākyam vākya viśāradaḥ |
pratyuvāca mahāprāGYo mārīco rākṣaseśvaram
verses.translation: On hearing that idea of the chief of demons Ravana in abducting Seetha, Maareecha, a well-informed one and an articulator spoke to the lord of demons in reply.

glosses.meaning: that, sentence - that idea of abduction, on hearing

verses.devanagari:
सुलभाः पुरुषा राजन् सततम् प्रिय वादिनः |
अप्रियस्य च पथ्यस्य वक्ता श्रोता च दुर्लभः
verses.iast:
sulabhāḥ puruṣā rājan satatam priya vādinaḥ |
apriyasya ca pathyasya vak{}tā śrotā ca durlabhaḥ
verses.translation: "It will always be easy to get people who talk pleasantly, oh, king, but it is impossible to get them who talk judgementally and give suggestions that may be apparently insipid, but that are recuperative, more so, it is impossible to get listeners of such advises.
notes: There are many who render advises without weighing pros and cons, but just to get along and please their master. There will be none to suggest expeditiously, though that suggestion presently will be unpleasant and unsavoury like a recuperative insipid diet, but in reality, it is result-oriented. Even if such an advisor suggests in earnest, he will have no listener who listens earnestly and effectuates it. So, listen to my words that may now be unsavoury, but will prove beneficial to you in long run, if you can foresee your future properly. Dharmaakuutam says: anena sva prayojana virodha sankayā rāja buddhi anusāreṇa vaktāro mantriṇaḥ sulabhāḥ - kintu anartha paryavasāyino rājabuddhim tiraskritya śubhodarka vaktāro mantriṇo durlabhā iti sūcitam- then the commentator goes on to quote vidura niiti from Maha Bharata, wherein it is said: yo hi dharma samāśritya hatvā bhatruḥ priyārthe | apriyāṇi āha pathyāni tena rājā sahāyavān || sulabhāḥ puruṣā rājan satatam priya vādinaḥ | apriyasya ca pathyasya vaktā śrotā ca durlabhaḥ || The last two foots may be observed because they are similar to the above verse of Ramayana, by such similarities some hold the opinion that Maha Bharata is an explanation to Ramayana.

verses.devanagari:
न नूनम् बुध्यसे रामम् महावीर्यम् गुण उन्नतम् |
अयुक्त चारः चपलो महेन्द्र वरुण उपमम्
verses.iast:
na nūnam budhyase rāmam mahāvīryam guṇa unnatam |
ayuk{}ta cāraḥ capalo mahendra varuṇa upamam
verses.translation: "Definitely you do not apperceive Rama who is decidedly dynamic and exaltedly adept, for you are impetuous and desultory in dealing with your spies, but that Rama is identical to the thunderous Mahendra and tempestuous Varuna, the Rain-god.

glosses.meaning: not, having, by spies - exclusionary, desultory of spies
[thunderous] Mahendra, [tempestuous] Varuna, God of Rain, alike - is Rama

verses.devanagari:
अपि स्वस्ति भवेत् तात सर्वेषाम् भुवि रक्षसाम् |
अपि रामो न संक्रुद्धः कुर्यात् लोकम् अराक्षसम्
verses.iast:
api svasti bhavet tāta sarveṣām bhuvi rakṣasām |
api rāmo na saṅkruddhaḥ kuryāt lokam arākṣasam
verses.translation: "Oh, boy, will there be safety to all demons on earth? Or, that highly enraged Rama will render this world de-demonised!
notes: '...but for you...' 'Will you let the demons on earth live, or, would like to eradicate them through Rama, through your obsessions.' The second thought has come true when Rama eliminated all demons.

verses.devanagari:
अपि ते जीवित अंताय न उत्पन्ना जनकात्मजा |
अपि सीता निमित्तम् च न भवेत् व्यसनम् महत्
verses.iast:
api te jīvita aṃtāya na utpannā janakātmajā |
api sītā nimittam ca na bhavet vyasanam mahat
verses.translation: "Has this Seetha, the daughter of Janaka, taken birth to end your life, or what! And because of this Seetha will there be a great disaster, so to speak!

glosses.meaning: even, not, took birth - has she taken birth
even, also, not, be there [will there be a disaster, so to speak.]

verses.devanagari:
अपि त्वाम् ईश्वरम् प्राप्य काम वृत्तम् निरंकुशम् |
न विनश्येत् पुरी लंका त्वया सह स राक्षसा
verses.iast:
api tvām īśvaram prāpya kāma vṛttam niraṃkuśam |
na vinaśyet purī laṃkā tvayā saha sa rākṣasā
verses.translation: "Egocentric and rampant, such as you are, on acquiring you as her lord, will the City of Lanka be doomed along with her demons, and you put together, or what!

glosses.meaning: in independent thinking, wrapped up - egocentric
not, doomed, even [will it be doomed or what.]

verses.devanagari:
त्वत् विधः काम वृत्तो हि दुःशीलः पाप मंत्रितः |
आत्मानम् स्व जनम् राष्ट्रम् स राजा हन्ति दुर्मतिः
verses.iast:
tvat vidhaḥ kāma vṛtto hi duḥśīlaḥ pāpa maṃtritaḥ |
ātmānam sva janam rāṣṭram sa rājā hanti durmatiḥ
verses.translation: "Any king of your like who is with a self-will, ill-will, ensorcelled by evil, and malicious in intent, that king alone ruins his own city-state, his own people, even himself, as a matter of actual fact.
notes: For this the commentator says: anena dur mantritaH kaamavritto naya dveSii raajaa sakala mantri vargeNa aishvaryenA saha nashyati iti uktam - tathaa ca kaamandake - anaatmavaan naya dveSii vardhaya ari sampadaH | praapyaa api mahad aishvaryam saha tena vinashyati || Dharmaakuutam being an encyclopedic commentary on Ramayana quotes Kamandaka etc., in such matters of dharma. The availability of the books quoted by the commentator of Dharmaakuutam in reprint is doubtful, where Dharmaakuutam itself is unavailable in full, in these days.

glosses.meaning: ruins, as a matter of (actual) fact.

verses.devanagari:
न च पित्रा परित्यक्तो न अमर्यादः कथंचन |
न लुब्धो न च दुःशीलो न च क्षत्रिय पांसनः
न च धर्म गुणैर् हीनैः कौसल्या आनंद वर्धनः |
न च तीक्ष्णो हि भूतानाम् सर्व भूत हिते रतः
verses.iast:
na ca pitrā parityak{}to na amaryādaḥ kathaṃcana |
na lubdho na ca duḥśīlo na ca kṣatriya pāṃsanaḥ
na ca dharma guṇair hīnaiḥ kausalyā ānaṃda vardhanaḥ |
na ca tīkṣṇo hi bhūtānām sarva bhūta hite rataḥ
verses.translation: "Rama the enhancer of his mother Kausalya's happiness is completely forsaken by his father - no, he is not; there is unseemliness in him - no, not in the least; he is out of character - no; he is selfish - no; he is an ignoble Kshatriya - no, not at all; and he is neither a debased one insofar as the merits of righteousness are concerned, nor he is atrocious towards living beings, for he takes delight in the welfare of all beings.

glosses.meaning: with righteous, attributes, a debased one
towards living beings atrocious one, he is not, also
all, beings, in welfare, takes delight.

verses.devanagari:
वंचितम् पितरम् दृष्ट्वा कैकेय्या सत्य वादिनम् |
करिष्यामि इति धर्मात्मा ततः प्रव्रजितो वनम्
verses.iast:
vaṃcitam pitaram dṛṣṭvā kaikeyyā satya vādinam |
kariṣyāmi iti dharmātmā tataḥ pravrajito vanam
verses.translation: "On seeing his father who is a proponent of truth, and whom Kaikeyi has outwitted, that virtue-souled Rama neatly decamped from Ayodhya saying that 'I will prove my father to be a real proponent of truth.'

glosses.meaning: truth, who is a proponent, such a father - Dasharatha
I will make - I will prove that my father is the real proponent of truth

verses.devanagari:
कैकेय्याः प्रिय कामार्थम् पितुर् दशरथस्य च |
हित्वा राज्यम् च भोगान् च प्रविष्टो दण्डका वनम्
verses.iast:
kaikeyyāḥ priya kāmārtham pitur daśarathasya ca |
hitvā rājyam ca bhogān ca praviṣṭo daṇḍakā vanam
verses.translation: "Discarding the kingdom and even royal-comforts Rama entered Dandaka forest only to fulfil the cherish of Kaikeyi, viz., kingdom for her son Bharata, and even that of Dasharatha, viz., to remain loyal to his promise to Kaikeyi.

verses.devanagari:
न रामः कर्कशः तात न अविद्वान् न अजित इन्द्रियः |
अनृतम् न श्रुतम् चैव नैव त्वम् वक्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
na rāmaḥ karkaśaḥ tāta na avidvān na ajita indriyaḥ |
anṛtam na śrutam caiva naiva tvam vak{}tum ar.hhasi
verses.translation: "Rama is ruthless - no; an unscholarly one - no; unconquered are his senses - no; and oh, boy, it is unapt of you to speak of impalpable and unheard-of topics in this way.

glosses.meaning: un, scholarly one, he is not
un, conquered, [his] senses, he is not
not, palpable - impalpable - are these slanders
not, this way, to speak of, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
रामो विग्रहवान् धर्मः साधुः सत्य पराक्रमः |
राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवानाम् इव वासवः
verses.iast:
rāmo vigrahavān dharmaḥ sādhuḥ satya parākramaḥ |
rājā sarvasya lokasya devānām iva vāsavaḥ
verses.translation: "Rama is the embodiment of righteousness, he is an equable person with truthfulness as his valour, and as with Indra to all gods he is the king of entire world.
notes: Rama's principles alone make him victorious, as he does not deviate from the path of righteousness. And by not deviating from the path of righteousness, he is truly valorous and the question of his defeat does not arise, because he will abide by his conscience.

glosses.meaning: for entire, world, he is king.

verses.devanagari:
कथम् नु तस्य वैदेहीम् रक्षिताम् स्वेन तेजसा |
इच्छसे प्रसभम् हर्तुम् प्रभाम् इव विवस्वतः
verses.iast:
katham nu tasya vaidehīm rakṣitām svena tejasā |
icchase prasabham hartum prabhām iva vivasvataḥ
verses.translation: "Rama's proper resplendence is protecting Vaidehi. How then you really wish to forcibly rob her off from Rama, as though wishing to rob the Sun of his resplendence.
notes: Incidentally, Prabha is the name of sun's brilliance and she is the wife of Sun, and if she is to be separated from sun, only an eternal gloom overcasts the world. Ravana has no doubt controlled natural forces like sun, moon, rivers etc., but not altogether eradicated or upturned their functions. Then, is it possible to Ravana and hosts of his demonic-adherents to thrive in an unnatural gloom? This is the doubt of Maareecha.

glosses.meaning: by his - Rama's, individual - proper, by resplendence
to rob, how, you wish, really.

verses.devanagari:
शर अर्चिषम् अनाधृष्यम् चाप खड्ग इन्धनम् रणे |
राम अग्निम् सहसा दीप्तम् न प्रवेष्टुम् त्वम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
śara arciṣam anādhṛṣyam cāpa khaḍga indhanam raṇe |
rāma agnim sahasā dīptam na praveṣṭum tvam arhasi
verses.translation: "Arrows as it jets of fire, bow and sword as it firewood that fire called Rama will be blazing in war, and it will be inapt of you to enter into such an uninfringeable fire, recklessly.

glosses.meaning: not, to be meddled with - uninfringeable

verses.devanagari:
धनुर् व्यादित दीप्त आस्यम् शर अर्चिषम् अमर्षणम् |
चाप बाण धरम् तीक्ष्णम् शत्रु सेना अपहारिणम्
राज्यम् सुखम् च संत्यज्य जीवितम् च इष्टम् आत्मनः |
न अति आसादयितुम् तात राम अंतकम् इह अर्हसि
verses.iast:
dhanur vyādita dīpta āsyam śara arciṣam amarṣaṇam |
cāpa bāṇa dharam tīkśṇam śatru senā apahāriṇam
rājyam sukham ca saṃtyajya jīvitam ca iṣṭam ātmanaḥ |
na ati āsādayitum tāta rāma aṃtakam iha ar.hhasi
verses.translation: "With the bow stretched to his ear becoming a gaping mouth spouting flames, arrows becoming tongues of fire spewed forth from that flaming mouth, he that Rama the reified Terminator will become fierce and insufferable when he wields bow and arrows, and oh, dear boy Ravana, it will be inapt of you to at once draw pretty nigh of such an annihilator of the armies of enemies, on discarding your kingdom, comforts and even the dear life of yours.

glosses.meaning: one who batters] = enemy, armies, stealer of - annihilator of
ati aasaadayitum = much, nearing - to draw pretty nigh of him

verses.devanagari:
अप्रमेयम् हि तत् तेजो यस्य सा जनकात्मजा |
न त्वम् समर्थः ताम् हर्तुम् राम चाप आश्रयाम् वने
verses.iast:
aprameyam hi tat tejo yasya sā janakātmajā |
na tvam samarthaḥ tām hartum rāma cāpa āśrayām vane
verses.translation: "Which Rama's wife is Janaka's daughter that Rama is indeed with an inestimable resplendence, and it will be incapable of you to steal Seetha while such a Rama's bow safeguards her in the forest, besides the firewall called his resplendence.
notes: This can be said 'Rama's resplendence is inestimable and Seetha is his wife.' But keeping the import of Seetha's words as at 3-9-15 'if fuel is available in adjacency of burning fire, the luminosity of the fire also enhances immensely,' and when the factor of resplendence is taken, it is not Rama's resplendence alone that is described, but Seetha's also. Again, it is not that some part of Rama's resplendence is taken out and put in Seetha. It is an indivisible radiance of that couple like that of Sun and his wife Prabha, as said earlier by Maareecha. Seetha is not directly said by her name but her father Janaka's name is brought in, because Janaka is both a rājarṣiand brahmarṣiKingly-saint and Brahman-sage, as well. And Janaka is capable of saying idam brahmam idam kśātram śāpat api śarāt api'here is Brahma-hood and here is Kshatriya-hood, either by malediction or by arrow, whichever meetly of you, you can confront me.' This apart, it is said that 'a pertinent devotion to a god makes the devotee like that god alone.' śraddhayā devo devatvam aśnuteand Seetha is the devotee of Rama and she became one with Rama. Thereby, there is twofold resplendence, namely, that of Rama and that of Seetha, so it is inapt of you to make any useless effort when everything is firewalled.

glosses.meaning: which one's - which Rama's wife is
not, measurable - with inestimable, resplendence - highly valrous - indeed
Rama's, bow, who is safeguarded - Seetha

verses.devanagari:
तस्य वै नर सिंहस्य सिंह उरस्कस्य भामिनी |
प्राणेभ्यो अपि प्रियतरा भार्या नित्यम् अनुव्रता
verses.iast:
tasya vai nara siṃhasya siṃha uraskasya bhāminī |
prāṇebhyo api priyatarā bhāryā nityam anuvratā
verses.translation: "That lady Seetha is his wife, dearest than the lives of that lion-chested lion-man Rama, and in truth, she is avowed to follow him alone, in perpetuity.

glosses.meaning: by lives [of Rama,] even, dearest, wife
always - in perpetuity, his - him alone
following, avowed - avowed to follow him

verses.devanagari:
न सा धर्षयितुम् शक्या मैथिली ओजस्विनः प्रिया |
दीप्तस्य इव हुत आशस्य शिखा सीता सुमध्यमा
verses.iast:
na sā dhar.hṣayitum śakyā maithilī ojasvinaḥ priyā |
dīptasya iva huta āśasya śikhā sītā sumadhyamā
verses.translation: "As the spire of blazing ritual fire cannot be abused, so also, she that curvaceous Maithili, the cherished wife of that dynamic Rama, is an impossibility for any abuse.

glosses.meaning: blazing, ritual fire's, spire, as with

verses.devanagari:
किम् उद्यमम् व्यर्थम् इमम् कृत्वा ते राक्षसाधिप |
दृष्टः चेत् त्वम् रणे तेन तत् अंतम् तव जीवितम्
verses.iast:
kim udyamam vyartham imam kṛtvā te rākṣasādhipa |
dṛṣṭaḥ cet tvam raṇe tena tat aṃtam tava jīvitam
verses.translation: "Oh, king of demons, What is the result in making such a futile effort? If that Rama glances at you in a given war that alone ends your life.
notes: The very start for any negative activity itself is self-ruinous to the starter. anena sarva anarthaka kāraṇa bhūto balavat virodho na kārya iti sūcitam - tathā ca prācīnāḥ - - anucita karma ārambhaḥ sva jana virodho balīyasā spardhā | pramadā jane viśvāso mrityu dvārāṇi catvāri || dk 'undesirable activity, starting that activity, too much of enmity with one's own people, too much belief in one's own womenfolk... are the four doors to death...' Hence, Maareecha is advising Ravana not to embark on a wrong foot, and even if Seetha is forcibly abducted, she cannot be possessed because she surrounded by a firewall, namely the resplendence of that couple.

glosses.meaning: to you, what - what is the result
your, life, that, alone, ends - that glance itself ends your life.

verses.devanagari:
जीवितम् च सुखम् चैव राज्यम् चैव सुदुर्लभम् |
यत् इच्छसि चिरम् भोक्तुम् मा कृथा राम विप्रियम्
verses.iast:
jīvitam ca sukham caiva rājyam caiva sudurlabham |
yat icchasi ciram bhok{}tum mā kṛthā rāma vipriyam
verses.translation: "If you cherish to take pleasure for a long time in your life, in your comforts and also thus in your kingdom, which kingdom is highly impossible to achieve, do not do anything unpleasant to Rama.

glosses.meaning: your life, also, comforts, also thus
if] = for a long, to enjoy, wish, which - if you wish

verses.devanagari:
स सर्वैः सचिवैः सार्धम् विभीषण पुरस्कृतैः |
मंत्रयित्वा तु धर्मिष्ठैः कृत्वा निश्चयम् आत्मनः |
दोषाणाम् च गुणानाम् च संप्रधार्य बल अबलम्
आत्मनः च बलम् ज्ञात्वा राघवस्य च तत्त्वतः |
हितम् हि तव निश्चित्य क्षमम् त्वम् कर्तुम् अर्हसि
verses.iast:
sa sarvaiḥ sacivaiḥ sārdham vibhīṣaṇa puraskṛtaiḥ |
maṃtrayitvā tu dharmiṣṭhaiḥ kṛtvā niścayam ātmanaḥ |
doṣāṇām ca guṇānām ca sampradhārya bala abalam
ātmanaḥ ca balam GYātvā rāghavasya ca tattvataḥ |
hitam hi tava niścitya kṣamam tvam kartum ar.hhasi
verses.translation: "Such as you are, you should firstly deliberate with all of your ministers that have a righteous bearing, duly keeping your brother Vibheeshana at the helm of affairs, and then you take a decision on your own considering rights and wrongs of the case, and bearing in mind about your own strengths and weakness, and even on making sure of Raghava's capability in its reality, and then it will be apt of you to take up befitting action that will be conducive to your interests.

glosses.meaning: on your own, decision, on making
capability, in reality, on making sure of

verses.devanagari:
अहम् तु मन्ये तव न क्षमम् रणे
समागमम् कोसल राज सूनुना |
इदम् हि भूयः शृणु वाक्यम् उत्तमम्
क्षमम् च युक्तम् च निशाचर अधिप
verses.iast:
aham tu manye tava na kṣamam raṇe
samāgamam kosala rāja sūnunā |
idam hi bhūyaḥ śṛṇu vākyam uttamam
kṣamam ca yuk{}tam ca niśācara adhipa
verses.translation: "Oh, king of nightwalkers Ravana, I for myself deem that your confrontation with Rama, the prince of Kosala, in a war is improper, and a better, befitting, and a reasonable one is this advise of mine, to which you may listen further.

glosses.meaning: proper, not, I deem - I deem it as improper
